title: TD-STGT: A Spatio-Temporal Graph Transformer for Mobile Traffic Demand Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2609.06636v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fine-grained mobile traffic demand forecasting is essential for long-term planning of 5G and future 6G networks, including radio upgrades, site densification, backhaul expansion, and spectrum activation. This paper proposes the Traffic Demand Spatio-Temporal Graph Transformer (TD-STGT), a graph neural forecasting framework for predicting changes in wireless mobile traffic demand across fine geographic grids. The framework uses a population-scaled demand proxy developed from crowdsourced mobile measurements and daytime population information. Experiments across five Canadian metropolitan regions show that TD-STGT achieves the best performance in forecasting grid-level demand changes, reaching a $\Delta R^2$ of 0.462 and reducing $\Delta$RMSE by 5.7\% relative to the strongest baseline. translated_title: TD-STGT：一种用于移动流量需求预测的时空图Transformer
translated_abstract: 细粒度的移动流量需求预测对于5G及未来6G网络的长期规划至关重要，包括无线设备升级、站点加密、回传网络扩容以及频谱激活等。本文提出了流量需求时空图Transformer（TD-STGT），这是一个用于预测精细地理网格上无线移动流量需求变化的图神经网络预测框架。该框架使用了基于众包移动测量数据和白天人口信息构建的按人口规模缩放的需求代理指标。在加拿大五个大都市区的实验表明，TD-STGT在预测网格级需求变化方面取得了最佳性能，ΔR²达到0.462，且相对于最强基线模型将ΔRMSE降低了5.7%。所提出的模型为识别需求压力持续增加的区域并优先安排未来移动网络容量升级提供了实用工具。
tldr: 本文提出TD-STGT时空图Transformer框架，利用基于众包移动测量与白天人口数据构建的需求代理指标，在加拿大五个大都市区的细粒度网格级移动流量需求变化预测中取得最优性能，为网络容量升级规划提供实用工具。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TD-STGT, a spatio-temporal graph Transformer leveraging a population-scaled demand proxy built from crowdsourced mobile measurements and daytime population data, achieving state-of-the-art performance in fine-grained grid-level mobile traffic demand forecasting across five Canadian metropolitan regions.
